title: 今だけ！パワースポット

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, when I'm strolling around town, I spot Matikanefukukitaru rolling a die rather earnestly.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hmm, a two… An even number means choosing the street on the left!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hey there, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well you see… last night, a divine revelation appeared in my dreams!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It just so happens that there's a new, super strong sacred site around here right now! But its power will only last a short time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Directions did not come included with the revelation, but that's no problem! For this lucky die will lead me to the promised land!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: …First, it seems to have led me right to you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hmm… This can be no mere coincidence! I presume this means you will be the one to guide me to the site!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Please, Trainer! Throw the die and show me the way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a bit too late to turn her down, so I guess I'll give it a go…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: A three! An odd number means we go down the street on the right… That's the way to the station!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: So fate desires us to take the train! Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! I can feel it! We're getting closer to the sacred site! Isn't this exciting?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now to find out which station to get off at. Let us consult the die!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A one would mean the next station, a two the station after that, and so on… A six would take us to the very last stop. I roll the die on the palm of my hand, which gives me…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: A one! Then we need to get off at the next sta—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The train suddenly lurches, causing the die to tumble out of my hand.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Now it's a six!
choice_data_list: Which one do we go with?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hm… This is quite the predicament!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you always lead me down the right path! So please, I ask for you to make the final decision!
choice_data_list: One. Let's get off at the next station.
Six. Let's stay on until the final stop.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Understood! I can't wait to see what we find!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wow, so this is the sacred site! The mystic energy here is off the charts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like any other part of town to me, but we roll the die and keep on walking.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Look at that sign! "Holy Smokes Steakhouse"! Is this one of the area's local delights?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's the perfect name for a sacred site! Let's go see what they have!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ooh, should I eat seven skewers for luck? Or maybe eight for prosperity!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Check out that big sculpture in front of the museum!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wow, it's reflecting so much light! So sparkly! I bet it's supercharged with the sun's energy, right down to the core!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Why don't we try touching it for some of that power! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Aaaand touch!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whew! What a day! I had so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm ready to take on the world! Now that's the power of visiting a supercharged, limited-time-only sacred site!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Um… How was today for you, Trainer? I ended up dragging you around all day…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: R-really? I'm happy to hear that! Plus, we got ourselves a whole lot of power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There didn't seem to be anything miraculous about today's events, but Matikanefukukitaru and I had a great time regardless.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I wouldn't mind if more divine revelations like this came my way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Well, maybe I shouldn't get too greedy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But… it'd be nice to enjoy ourselves like that every once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hehe, maybe I'll ask Shiraoki for another revelation before bed tonight.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Understood! Onward! With you by my side, I can travel to the ends of the earth!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We get off at the last stop to find an open, serene landscape expanding into the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mmm! The air here is so clean and crisp! Even the great outdoors is flush with power!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I think we're onto something wonderful! Let's go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I roll the die under her expectant gaze, and we press on diligently. And on, and on, and on…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, looks like this is the end of the road!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I think this might just be it—the supercharged, limited-time-only sacred site! Now what miracles await us?!
choice_data_list: Do you really expect a miracle to happen?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Of course! You're the one who led us here, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says this with a smile so bright it makes me hopeful for a miracle myself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what was that sound?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer! Look up at the sky! Some kind of light is coming this way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: H-huh?! Whaaa—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A dazzling light, followed by a thunderous clap, seizes all my senses…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Did… d-did you see that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It was a UFO!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It had to be! That was a gift—power from the cosmos!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wasn't able to see it clearly for myself, but if she's happy, who am I to argue?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You really are my destined partner! What an auspicious event your guidance has brought upon us!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm sure more amazing things are in store for us if we stick together! Don't you think?
